_comment: Single-scene (00861-GLAQ4DNUx5U) set with the instruction styles as evenly represented as the grammar allows. Two knobs do the work: balance_weights.styles dominates the fit error, and length_ratios lean long -- a length-2 or length-3 episode has almost no room for AR_post (needs an AR_pre plus one intervening subgoal) or AB_pre+OR_post (needs a prior visit), so short episodes are what force S to dominate. ab/or distance targets are left off so the balancer spends its freedom on the style dimension.
